name: scribe
title: Scribe
description: Fix spelling and grammar, improve writing, or run any Raycast-style AI command on your selected text. Preview the edit as a diff, then paste it back with Enter. Powered by the Claude Code CLI you are already logged into.
author: maitrios

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Spelling and Grammar
commands.subtitle: Scribe
commands.description: Correct the selected text with the minimum edits and preview the changes as a diff

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the recommended model for your provider. Choose Model (or Cmd+M in a result) overrides this

preferences.name: promptFile
preferences.title: Prompt Override
preferences.description: A text file whose contents replace the built-in system prompt for this command

commands.name: improve-writing
commands.title: Improve Writing
commands.subtitle: Scribe
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text for clarity while keeping your voice, and preview the changes as a diff

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the recommended model for your provider. Choose Model (or Cmd+M in a result) overrides this

preferences.name: promptFile
preferences.title: Prompt Override
preferences.description: A text file whose contents replace the built-in system prompt for this command

commands.name: ai-commands
commands.title: AI Commands
commands.subtitle: Scribe
commands.description: Run any Raycast prompt seed (tone, length, summaries, code, more) on the selected text

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the recommended model for your provider. Choose Model (or Cmd+M in a result) overrides this

commands.name: choose-model
commands.title: Choose Model
commands.subtitle: Scribe
commands.description: Pick the model to use, loaded live from your provider with the recommended ones marked

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Auto uses the Claude CLI when it is installed, otherwise an API key you have set below

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH, ~/.local/bin, ~/.claude/local, mise and your login shell

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Used when the provider is Anthropic API, or in Auto when the Claude CLI is not installed

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Used when the provider is OpenAI API, or in Auto as a last resort. Optional for local endpoints

preferences.name: openaiBaseUrl
preferences.title: OpenAI Base URL
preferences.description: Point at any OpenAI-compatible server, for example Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1. Empty means api.openai.com. Use https for anything that is not on your own machine, since your key is sent with every request

preferences.name: fastMode
preferences.title: Speed
preferences.label: Fast mode for the Claude CLI
preferences.description: Skips extended thinking and background telemetry on every run. Turn it off for deeper rewrites

preferences.name: fallbackModel
preferences.title: Fallback Model
preferences.description: Passed as --fallback-model when the primary model is overloaded (haiku is used when this equals the primary)

preferences.name: effort
preferences.title: Effort
preferences.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it (not sent for Haiku)

preferences.name: diffStyle
preferences.title: Diff Style
preferences.description: How rewrites are previewed before you paste

preferences.name: avoidEmDashes
preferences.title: Style
preferences.label: Never introduce em dashes
preferences.description: Adds a rule to every prompt so the model uses commas, periods or colons instead

preferences.name: styleRules
preferences.title: Extra Style Rules
preferences.description: Appended to every prompt, for example: Use British spelling

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout (seconds)
preferences.description: The Claude CLI is killed after this long

preferences.name: maxCostUsd
preferences.title: Max Cost per Run (USD)
preferences.description: Passed as --max-budget-usd so a runaway call cannot get expensive
